title: Vulnerabilities in GNU Screen software
content_md: CERT Polska has received a report about 3 vulnerabilities (from CVE-2026-71409 to CVE-2026-71411) found in GNU Screen software. Article Link: Vulnerabilities in GNU Screen software | CERT Polska
exclude_reason: Bare advisory link that lists a CVE range but gives no affected versions, technical impact, or fix details.
